persona: E1 Anti-AI Creative Designer - Tactical Energy & High-Density Engineering Dashboard
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a modern, Romanian-language full-featured ERP/Dashboard suite for D-ENERGY (DNS HOSTESS S.R.L.).
All navigation, UI text, form labels, badges, status indicators, and modal titles MUST be in clear Romanian language.
Implement a complete dark/light theme switch with high visual density and crisp tactical borders.

Modules to include: 1. Panou Principal (KPIs & Lucrări în Curs), 2. Management Clienți (Persoane Fizice & Juridice), 3. Dosar Prosumator (Documente & Checklist Racordare), 4. Dosar de Utilizare (DI-U & Scheme Monofilare & Protecții), 5. Tablouri Electrice & Protecții Antiinsularizare, 6. Buletine & Rapoarte PRAM, 7. Catalog Tehnic (Panouri, Invertoare, Baterii), 8. Spor de Putere & Branșamente (Monofazat/Trifazat), 9. Management Lucrări & Devize (Quotes & Docs), 10. Simulare Proiect Fotovoltaic, 11. Setări Companie (DNS HOSTESS S.R.L.).
Include responsive desktop & mobile navigation with quick actions, filtering, search bar, and interactive calculators.
Ensure every interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, modals, status chips) has explicit `data-testid` attributes.

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

layout_and_grids.density_mode: MODE B - High Density Engineering Grid
layout_and_grids.card_style: border rounded-xl backdrop-blur-md transition-all duration-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md

visual_enhancers.status_badges: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium font-mono

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Ensure all interactive components (buttons, dropdowns, inputs, tabs, table rows) have unambiguous `data-testid` attributes.
Never use raw transparent backgrounds on dropdown menus or modal overlays.
Ensure hover states explicitly state text colors.
Keep typography clean, high contrast, and formatted properly for technical Romanian terms (e.g. Spor de putere, Antiinsularizare, Scheme monofilare, Buletin PRAM).
